name: pdk-pvanalytics-dataframe
instr:
Since our sites moved to the new data logger, the daily completeness numbers from `pvanalytics.quality.gaps` stopped making sense. `completeness_score` gives full days a third or more than 1, and `trim_incomplete` keeps stretches where a logger was down for whole days. A sample of the weekly exports for two sites is in `/data/das-exports/`.

I build the Series from one site's exports concatenated in order, rows in file order, with `ac_power` as the values (blank is NaN) and `timestamp` converted to America/Denver as the index, and pass it to `completeness_score`, `complete` and `trim_incomplete`.

A day's score should be the fraction of that local calendar day covered by readings with a value, where a reading covers one logging interval and no interval counts twice. A day with a value at every interval scores 1, including the days the clocks change. With `keep_index=False` I want one score per local day from the first to the last, 0 for a day with no readings. Results with one value per reading should line up with the Series I passed in. A day with no readings is incomplete, so `trim_incomplete` must not count it in a run of good days. A series with fewer than two distinct timestamps should raise `ValueError`.

Series in the old format (a row at every interval, blank when missing) should score as they do now, and the existing tests in `/app/pvanalytics/tests` and `flake8 .` in `/app` should stay clean. There's no network; pvanalytics is installed editable in `/opt/venv`.
